story.title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers

draft:
I've been noticing a trend of discontent among tech professionals. 
As someone in the software industry, I find it concerning that many are losing faith in their careers. 
This shift in sentiment is not just about job dissatisfaction, but a deeper questioning of purpose. 
What will it take for tech workers to regain confidence in their field?
